description: The bar chart illustrates the Execution Accuracy of two different methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories in the following order: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total, without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis represents the value and is labeled "Execution Accuracy," utilizing a linear scale with a visible range from 20 to 60 and tick marks at regular intervals of 10. Notably, the vertical axis baseline begins at 20 rather than 0. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a pair of bars. According to the legend positioned at the top, the light blue bars represent NatSQL and the dark blue bars represent TA-SQL, with the light blue bar consistently positioned to the left of the dark blue bar within each group. Every bar is visually emphasized with an exact numerical annotation at its top. For the "Simple" category, NatSQL is 60.21 and TA-SQL is 63.14. In the "Moderate" category, NatSQL is 39.64 and TA-SQL is 48.60. For the "Challenging" category, NatSQL is 32.32 and TA-SQL is 36.11. Finally, in the "Total" category, NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The shortest bar in the chart is the NatSQL bar in the Challenging category at 32.32, while the tallest bar is the TA-SQL bar in the Simple category at 63.14. The categories are not sorted by numerical value, but rather follow a logical progression of difficulty followed by an aggregate total.
